crm_notes: Inbound SMB lead via self-serve signup (used free tier credits). Early discovery call 2026-03-03.
Primary contact: Alex Moreno (CTO). Small engineering team: 3 backend, 2 mobile. Building contextual assistant for their B2B mobile app.
Use-case: streaming chat with tool-calling to query internal product DB + structured JSON output for downstream ingestion.
What they tried: hosted API + streaming=true + functions schema passed in request. Getting inconsistent behavior:
- Sometimes model emits a function_call object (good). Other times returns plain text content that contains JSON payload (bad) -> client JSON.parse failures.

- On streaming responses, final function_call event sometimes arrives as a separate chunk without proper JSON framing; their client stops after first '
' chunk -> truncated payload.
- They used function_call: 'auto' initially, then tried explicit name; explicit name reduced variability but didn't eliminate occasional text-wrapped JSON.
Errors observed in logs: 'Unexpected token < in JSON at position 0' when downstream service tries to parse streaming chunks. Reported request_id rbx-99823 for one failing run.
Quote from Alex: "We need deterministic JSON out of the model so our ingestion pipeline never stalls. If streaming cuts mid-object, we have to fallback to heuristics — unacceptable."
Security/compliance: SOC2 baseline needed for contract. Prefer SSO/SAML and audit logs. No on-prem requirement right now (public cloud ok).
Cost sensitivity: SMB - tight budget. Interested in Hosted API but want predictable unit economics for streaming usage (tokens + streaming overhead).

Technical ask from call: 1) recommended request/headers/body shape for robust streaming + function calling; 2) examples for ensuring model returns function_call reliably (schema hints, temperature, system prompts); 3) sample server-side reassembly logic for chunked function_call JSON.
AE notes: Demo environment created in our org (demo-key-bridgeware). Shared streaming troubleshooting doc and minimal repro examples in Drive.
Next recommended step: custom mini-POC with our SE to reproduce truncation and recommend server/client best-practices. SE to join follow-up on 2026-03-16.
Potential upsell: if POC succeeds, convert to monthly committed hosted plan (expected ARR small but a good reference for in-app assistant).
